scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=gateway" "npm run dev --workspace=auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace=reservas-service"
scripts.db:setup: docker-compose up -d mysql mongo && sleep 10 && docker-compose exec -T mysql mysql -u root -prootpassword banco_goschool < database/mysql/schema.sql && docker-compose exec -T mongo mongosh banco_goschool database/mongo/indexes.js
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec -T mysql mysql -u root -prootpassword banco_goschool < database/mysql/seeds/demo-data.sql && docker-compose exec -T mongo mongosh banco_goschool database/mongo/seeds/demo-data.js
scripts.test: npx jest --projects gateway auth-service reservas-service shared
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules gateway/node_modules auth-service/node_modules reservas-service/node_modules shared/node_modules
